title: typha angustifolia var. angustata
intro: Typha angustifolia var. angustata, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Cattail or Lesser Bulrush, is a variety of the Typha angustifolia plant, a type of perennial aquatic plant that grows in wetlands and shallow water areas. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Typha angustifolia var. angustata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
